scope: The root ambiguity has the closed form Delta_j = -n_j e(1-w_j) mod m (verified against every measured twist), giving a SECOND condition m | n_j e(1-w_j) alongside Addendum 27's m | n_j e(w_j) -- together mu*_w | n_w with mu* = m/gcd(m, gcd(e(w), e(1-w))). This is the shape of CGZ's own D*[zeta_D] elements, whose multiplicity exists for exactly this reason. Residue-level infeasibility is a SOUND element-level obstruction (element solutions merge into residue ones; the converse is the Addendum-25 error and is not used): the combined condition is INFEASIBLE at m = 4, 6, 8, 12, 24 -- excluding THIS construction there, not eps_m as a map -- and FEASIBLE at m = 3, where an element-level representative meeting both conditions still has to be exhibited (the single-relation family contains none).
